translation.name: Rewrite Reality
profile: Rewrite Reality briefly transforms a nonmagical inanimate object into another ordinary nonmagical object of the same or smaller size. It can offer a creative solution to an obstacle, but its scope is precise. It does not allow unrestricted creation of life, artefacts or wealth. The name describes an exceptional magical moment, rather than a right to change any fact without further boundaries.

A suitable original target and a plan for the ten-minute duration are needed. The spell cannot create money or an exact copy of a unique key. Its single use per adventure gives the decision considerable weight. The party should consider how to use the temporarily transformed object and what to do when the effect ends, rather than relying on a permanent solution.

Exact effect: For 10 minutes, transforms the target into another ordinary nonmagical object of the same or smaller size. It cannot create a living being, an artefact, money or an exact copy of a unique key. Target: 1 nonmagical inanimate object no larger than a wagon. Duration: 10 minutes. Limit: once per adventure; requires knowledge of the spell. Use requires at least INT 18 and Level 25, the appropriate spellcasting ability and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

Target, duration, restrictions, and exact effect.

strings.Sesilatel okamžitě získá jednu dodatečno: The caster immediately gains one additional main action, during which no one else acts. The original turn order then resumes.
strings.1× za dobrodružství; rituál 10 minut; mi: Once per adventure; 10-minute ritual; outside combat
strings.Otevře průchod pouze do předem známého a: Opens a passage only to a world or plane already known and established in the story. Creatures and their carried equipment can pass through the gate.
strings.prázdný prostor pro bránu: an empty space for the gate
strings.1× za kampaň; vyžaduje znalost kouzla: Once per campaign; requires knowledge of the spell
strings.Vrátí stav hry přesně na začátek předcho: Returns the game state exactly to the start of the previous round or by at most 1 minute. Restores positions, HP, items and effects; the caster remembers the return.
strings.1 ochotná duše zemřelá nejvýše před 1 dn: 1 willing soul whose death occurred no more than 1 day ago
strings.1× za kampaň; nefunguje bez souhlasu duš: Once per campaign; requires the soul's consent and knowledge of the spell
strings.Navrátí duši do těla a cíl se probudí na: Returns the soul to its body, and the target awakens with 1 HP. This is an exception for stories in which actual death exists; basic player characters do not die at 0 HP.
strings.1 nemagický neživý předmět nejvýše velik: 1 nonmagical inanimate object no larger than a wagon
strings.Na 10 minut změní cíl v jiný běžný nemag: For 10 minutes, transforms the target into another ordinary nonmagical object of the same or smaller size. It cannot create a living being, an artefact, money or an exact copy of a unique key.
